title: McKee Dramatic (Value Shift & Tactics)
description: McKee dramatic beat: shifting emotional/thematic charge (positive to negative or vice versa) driven by evolving character tactics.
systemPromptDirective: Structure the scene around psychological negotiation and tactic shifts, pivoting the scene's core value charge from beginning to end.

fields.label: Value at Stake
fields.placeholder: e.g., Trust vs Betrayal, Freedom vs Captivity, Hope vs Despair
fields.helperText: The core human value that is tested and altered during this scene

fields.label: Opening Charge
fields.placeholder: e.g., Positive (+): Confident in their shared alliance
fields.helperText: The value state at the start of the scene (+ or -)

fields.label: Character Tactic Shifts
fields.placeholder: e.g., Starts with charm, shifts to guilt-tripping, escalates to overt blackmail
fields.helperText: How characters alter their approach as initial tactics fail to pierce defenses

fields.label: Closing Charge
fields.placeholder: e.g., Negative (-): Absolute disillusionment and broken bond
fields.helperText: The transformed value state by scene end, signaling a true narrative turn
